entities.name: Jaffna Kingdom
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Jaffna Kingdom, a political institution in Sri Lanka during Polonnaruwa Kingdom (1215–1310). Grew from Chola and Vijayabahu's Liberation and Parakramabahu the Great. Led to the emergence of Polonnaruwa Decline and Drift Southward.
